# redmuffin.net

Personal website and digital garden built with Blazor WebAssembly (.NET 9)
and Azure Static Web Apps. Features page load performance diagnostics,
a curated collection of videos and articles via Raindrop.io, and live
trimming/monitoring dashboards.

## Key pages

- `/` — Home page with performance dashboard
- `/page-load-speed` — Real-time Core Web Vitals and WASM diagnostics
- `/videos` — Curated video collection
- `/articles` — Curated article collection

## Technical notes

- Single-page Blazor WASM app with static prerendering
- Self-hosted fonts (Outfit, Font Awesome 6) via woff2
- All CSS compiled from SCSS via dart-sass, zero CDN dependencies
- Source: https://github.com/michaelvolz/redmuffin.Blazor.StaticWeb
